sources.68936a7a672ffe94a509446b description: He that steals honey, should beware of the sting.
sources.6751aedd068276747529227a description: Basic walls for a basic Tarkov citizen. Somewhat reminiscent of an old Soviet hospital.
sources.6751af2d8e1a942952aefef2 description: For those who seek peace and tranquility. Each hare and butterfly are hand-painted. A real master's work.
sources.6751af383e9bd9caef89db33 description: For Red mains. If anyone manages to sneak into your Hideout, the blood on the walls won't be as noticeable.
sources.6751af3fcb1d39998bfac87b description: The floor that came with the Hideout. If it's cleaned up, it would look "okay".
sources.6751af495b5b6eb3f4bf3e8c description: Perfect flooring for those who appreciate simplicity. And those who never take their shoes off.
sources.6751af8bdbb573047940a042 description: How did these drawings even get here? You should probably improve your security system.
sources.67547d0f059224f355d52c34 description: A floor exclusively for walking barefoot. However, it looks like real grass only from a distance.
sources.6757f7abb3db18ca36b80fa8 description: A target for the most precise.
sources.6757f843ef44ccd9cae9b4cd description: A target for real hunters. Making Jaeger proud.
sources.6757f86db8c6e4b9a80b3fd2 description: Let's see what kind of a shot you are, pilgrim. Take a crack at this bottle.
sources.6757f88b8455992ca790d75f description: A contrast of sectors allows you to shoot more accurately.
sources.6757f8a88e1a324c7432def2 description: A target that brings some variety to shooting practice.
sources.67584568886bcb95b7a4a7f7 description: For Blue mains. Blue is believed to be a calming color for the nervous system. With walls like this, you should be able to sleep better. A good lock on the door would help too.
sources.6758457c00ddf9fdaedf71e6 description: Fully exposed walls for brutalism lovers.
sources.6758458ea8fc011dd69a07a0 description: If you gaze long enough at these drawings, it will seem like they are gazing back at you.
sources.675845a78fc07a5b49df8378 description: For those who want to turn their Hideout into a trendy loft. Exposing the brick and removing layers of plaster takes quite a bit of effort. Hopefully, it's worth it.
sources.675845be076a984e69514f91 description: A fun color to elevate your mood. Or to go completely insane in a cheerful way.
sources.675845d08f12ba371ca6efa5 description: The luxury of silence. And marble.
sources.675845ef558bd99a397f1423 description: Who would actually think of decorating their Hideout in the style of an industrial factory? An ex-worker, obviously. Or someone with unusual tastes.
sources.675846123eb1552410f949e5 description: A surefire solution. Too bad this is the only wallpaper style you could find.
sources.67584672d50f6d3dec589959 description: Has a warm, familiar feel to it. It bounces underfoot and looks nice.
sources.675846870ef524572ad413b5 description: A good coating that requires little maintenance. Practical and stylish.
sources.675846a8606febda61651929 description: Is it actual marble or is it merely pretending to be? Either way, be careful: marble floors are usually very slippery.
sources.675846ccf4e8484562b07782 description: A brilliant solution for a manufacturing plant, but somewhat questionable for a living space. Who are we to stop you, though?
sources.675846f71b2620cfbdcbb438 description: Mechanic shared his favorite style. Too bad he didn't warn in advance that such floors are very awkward to clean.
sources.67584709106d54460af75877 description: Your grandma probably had the same flooring. Or your friend's grandma. Either way, it looks good.
sources.6758472232e5ca2c980a17ff description: Classic parquet. Wood and lacquer - nothing extra.
sources.6758517669cfc0195e555532 description: A charming ceiling for those who don't like the outdoors. Why leave the house when you can just paint the sun on the ceiling?
sources.675851bba67b0f994b89bd24 description: An untidy ceiling for those who don't care about the looks. It doesn't leak, and that's all that matters.
sources.675851d0e6b8a9cbae3e5aba description: Who in their right mind would paint something on the ceiling? Be on your guard: there's no telling what else these people might come up with.
sources.675851e45338344d8fe1ce6f description: Nothing special. Luckily there are no spider webs. Unless?
sources.6758521199c7b5040d87468d description: Visually makes the room look larger. A good choice for those who like more air.
sources.6758522a4d6d6674cd50e38f description: A non-fake, original production drop ceiling, the good stuff. For those who are particularly sensitive, it may evoke memories of office life from the past.
sources.6758523adf0e5f08d1d5c132 description: Unmaintained, but sturdy ceiling. When you look at it, you feel a strange desire to visit Factory once more.
sources.6758524ec55b4ffd1b46cfc2 description: The simplest of ceiling finishes. All the seams are sealed, no stains. It's not very cozy, but it does its main function quite well.
sources.67585260c0250fb99b3b9113 description: Looks like someone tried to whitewash it, but something went wrong. Your grandma's basement must have had one just like it.
sources.675a99f30fba9efc6a40481d description: Just an ordinary target, nothing special.
sources.67adb25c7a0e0fce8574438c description: They say our surroundings affect us. It's terrifying to imagine what someone would become after turning an ordinary shelter into the Minotaur's dungeon.
sources.67adb38d0217ccce16b5b08c description: The tiles on this floor have absorbed gallons of blood. Or perhaps even more.
sources.67adb4843fec17bf3ea9452e description: This ceiling is nothing sophisticated. The Minotaur doesn't need anything like that.
sources.6841c93d40f98448eafbe5fe description: A target for those who miss all the bar games.
sources.6841ca25a3202eb499cdee19 description: A target for sneaky rodent hunters.
sources.6841caa796e886f328e69606 description: Crows are clever birds. But in image form, they certainly won't outsmart you. Unless?
sources.6841cc541c407f8aa0e4f62b description: White walls will make the Hideout look more spacious. Like an office.
sources.6841ccf5cf47eb290b9fb24e description: A nice light-colored floor. Helps keep the eyes free of strain. It also keeps the dust almost invisible.
sources.6841cdb93de393b52dd49865 description: A white ceiling with gold inlays. Someone went to a lot of trouble to paint these stripes.
sources.673f06ffd971eef67d8cc504 description: You there, dog! Hand over your cash! Don't try anything smart. Drop your- Hold on a second. Let me see your face... Ahh, the prophecies were true after all. For you to be the chosen one, for you to be the one who escapes... But for that, you'll need my assistance. Find me a GPhone; make sure you don't get it from a trader. I'll reward you handsomely. Follow my guidance, and you shall reveal the secrets held underneath us this very moment - in Tarkov's underground.
sources.6740b1c44382955ae7e87eb9 description: Feel like expanding your wardrobe, eh? Want to feel a little bit more special? Decorate your gear? No worries, I got you. Bring me some materials, and I'll make sure you have access to my... lets say "expanded stock". Shadows guide you.
sources.673f0b6c85753ffd03ad5f34 description: I'll take your return as a sign you're ready for more work. A bunch of ex-USEC operators holed themselves up in that old water treatment plant near the Lighthouse and it's keeper. He's called me about a noise complaint, and wants those so-called "Rogues" knocked down a peg. Three of them should make the message clear. By the way, while you're there... ex-military and energy drinks go hand-in-hand. See if you can find me some - and I do mean find, Operator. I'll know if you've bought it from a trader. I want fresh, untampered cans. Bring four. Thank you, Operator.
sources.673f0daebb711e9700b60899 description: Operator, you've kept earning my trust again and again. This time, the task I have for you is of monumental importance. TerraGroup agents have found their new home - with the Svetloosersky "brothers". Find where they stored their gear. Sources tell me there's been increased activity around a temporary USEC encampment in the nature reserve. I heard Prapor screaming about a missing convoy near there, so expect trouble. There should be a field hospital there too, so bring me some CMS surgical kits. Once you've located and acquired their resources, bring the population of these Svetloozerskiy dogs down by a few - let's say five of them.
sources.673f0f4d219756e158de7ab3 description: Operator, allow me to introduce to you... to the 'Predator'. Thrown into a cage at a young age, they endured unthinkable cruelty - treated as a mere dog with a twisted piece of corrugated hose used as a leash. Retrieve the lost collar that once served as the shackle around the Predator's neck. Fetch it.
sources.6740b5875ef4d62a019c51f2 description: Operator, I'm glad to see you again. Listen carefully - you must head to the shore. Grab a suppressed weapon, dress as the embodiment of death, and reap the souls of the savages. With haste, Operator, time is a valuable thing.
sources.6740b70d0c2f488b92d69575 description: Operator, I come bearing news of the Predator's recent operation at the customs terminal. Find me the train wagon he used to infil. He did some dirty work around the area, dirty enough for one of the big bosses to come clean it up - I think 'Reshala' was his name. Anyways, leave the Predator some rations. 3 Water Bottles and 2 MREs should be enough. Good luck.
sources.6741d2a8ee39dbd555b6468d description: A rumour was started by a few ex-cultists once under my command. Hunt them down. They know too much to be captured, and are too dangerous to be kept alive. Though our tongues were bound by the Blade, I worry they would bark like dogs at the right moment... and the wrong time.
sources.6741d50ae7f5bd50d5034129 description: Operator, I'm glad you're here. Sit down. This little secret must stay between the two of us.. You know those cottages near the health resort? That's where that son of a bitch 'Sanitar' is holed up, with his cowardly group of "orderlies" scattered around. Ah... nevermind, just bring me some intel - physical and digital - along with some cameras and signal jammers. I'm going to plant some surveillance around his area. He thinks he's safe, and I want to prove him wrong.
sources.6741d6176c4b417a408d290f description: Operator, that son of a bitch slipped away and made it out of my assault on his cottage alive. He can't escape, he's more dangerous than you know. Think about it - a mere janitor has his own small laboratory in a top-secret area? It's absurd. There's more to this situation than meets the eye. He's got something I need, something of great value to our operation. I need you to track him down and ensure he doesn't leave alive. We can't let him out of our sight. This mission could be the key to unraveling the secrets TerraGroup holds, secrets that could change the course of history.
sources.6741d74a7ca8a4abfdf908c6 description: Operator, great news. Word has spread around Tarkov that you've eliminated Sanitar, and as a result, his rats have started to dig out his stashes. That's another opportunity to take what is rightfully ours. He left an untouched package in a villa near the Lighthouse. I've heard they made a final attempt to save that motherfucker. Go ahead and mark it - I'll send some of my boys at night. Another small request. I've been told his henchmen who were with him are dead. I need confirmation. Head to that RUAF outpost at the nature reserve - there should be a white cargo container filled with body bags. Find it, confirm the kills, and get out. Let's not make it too messy.
sources.6741d86720827d719dafa146 description: Operator, word is spreading that the Bloodhounds, led by a certain 'Den' and his scav companion 'Ryzhy,' have been making waves in Tarkov. They've garnered quite a reputation among the locals. Kharitonov contacted me, expressing concern about the Bloodhounds' release from the Arena, anticipating chaos that needs to be prevented. You're tasked with sending a message - eliminate three of the Bloodhounds as a warning, but try not to harm Den; he holds a close connection to Ivan. Plus, he could be helpful in the near future...
sources.6741da44d68092ca9722521a description: Welcome back - hey, you seem really off. Bloodhounds didn't treat you well, did they? Sit, you need to get some rest. I'll make you some great medicine, one of a kind. Just make sur- agh. I ran out of materials. Well, Operator, rest first, head back out to find what we need.
sources.6741dbba9e6d28c8ff0a700f description: Pal, let me tell you about this little adventure ahead of us. Our message to the Bloodhounds was received. They've know you for your deeds and connections, yet undervalue your actions and skills. Den and Ryzhy came back to Ivan's hideout and explained the situation. There was a set-up in a deal conducted between a group of rogue PMCs - they played dirty tricks on the Bloodhound's dealers. That's why they made their presence known. We've been tasked with finding out what the deal was, as Den didn't say too much. I think the deal was related to a keycard belonging to TerraGroup. I want you to go and look after that. Bring me a lab access keycard.
sources.6741dd080a4b6768df84d4ed description: Listen up, pal. I've got some grim news about those Bloodhounds wreaking havoc around Tarkov. They've pulled off a daring ambush on a TerraGroup vehicle as it navigated the streets around the customs terminal. I've got intel from the Predator on the sensitive documents stashed in that car, and where it was headed. Also, there has been rumours going around the recent van made it safely to the factories there and dumped a set of barrels in one of the abandoned factories.. I've got no idea what's in those barrels but its up to you to find out. Head there too, and mark it for me. Let me tell you - there's always a more ominous force at play. Aid me in tracking down that vehicle and the barrels. - I'll dispatch my crew to tear apart every inch of the area, extracting whatever they can. Thank you Operator.
sources.6741de5af218c3a4a71f659e description: Pal, the Predator informed me of yet another location in need of some tied up loose ends - this time it's the chemical plant. Use caution when entering, and get rid of any informants so they won't be able to pass the information of your arrival. It seems there's an abandoned medical tent near one of the exits. I need you to grab a sample and mark the hazmat suit, as there are traces of that strange liquid similar to what you found inside those barrels. Mark the medical boxes too, I'll send my men to retrieve the materials.
sources.6745faad87494344ac6986e7 description: Heed this: the Predator has whispered of the cultists' return to the shadows of Tarkov. My men... have fallen victim to these bastards, their gear now lost to the abyss. It falls upon you to reclaim what's ours. There will be ample compensation for your efforts. This task is of the utmost importance, that gear is critical to our operation. Fetch it.
sources.6745fdae9426c1e4a9fd5772 description:
Dear friend, 

 I am leaving you this note as we head out to gather resources. Once again, I require your assistance. My comrades and I are preparing to assault the remaining TerraGroup assets. While we are armed, our current arsenal falls short of what we're expecting to face. I kindly request your aid in acquiring: 
- 3 M4A1s 
- 2 AKMs 
-Ample ammunition for each 

 Perhaps you could approach some of the traders - they might be aware of our plans and willing to help. Your support is invaluable. 

Thank you, 
Artem
sources.67462d52d129aa9ebc6eb98d description: Friend, our raid went off without a hitch. The TerraGroup building was swarming with targets, but they scattered like insects after shots were fired. However, something peculiar caught my attention inside... Behind a locked door, I heard a familiar sound - an enigma I couldn't unravel. I attempted to breach the door but my shotgun did nothing. There's definitely something unusual happening behind it. I consulted an acquaintance skilled in the art of lockpicking. He mentioned a key known mysteriously as the something 'Meeting Room Key' that should get you in. Find this key. The room lies deep within the TerraGroup security post building on Tarkov's streets. Discover what secrets await inside.
sources.67463059a075ba4f50c0e396 description: My crew found out two things - One, Dennis has become entangled in this somehow. It suggests we've stumbled onto something serious. He shared details about those mysterious blue tapes you witnessed playing in the meeting room. It seems they're preparing for another EMP attack on Tarkov, but there's a crucial missing piece to this puzzle that eludes me. Two, I've also received word about members of my former crew lurking in the shadows of Customs warehouses, perhaps even collaborating with the Goons at the Fortress. Head there under the cover of night, and take these with you.
sources.6746319d051c463a810728fc description: Pal, it's time for you to visit the Lab. My last crew unfortunately didn't make it back from their expedition down there, but we did manage to retrieve some valuable information related to our operation. Before they exited, one of them spotted an unknown material spilled all over the yellow tent, but had no means of analyzing whatever it was. Bring a gas analyzer and study it. They also discovered a laptop emitting similar signals to the one Sanitar had in his wardrobe, behind a locked door. The crew mentioned a glassed meeting room, and that's where our conversation ended, so pick up your gear, prepare, and retrieve the information. Good luck, friend.
sources.67464750efd379bfffb1d539 description: It's time to hit TerraGroup, but we need to hit hard. Samoylov and I developed a more stable and efficient version of a USB Rubber Duck - lets call it a USB Groovey Duck. On your last journey in Labs, you most likely have already stumbled upon the numerous server racks scattered around. Plug it in and dump all the intel you can. We need this information for our coming assault on TerraGroup. Oh, last but not least, head over to Sanitar's workplace - you should be able to find more valuable information about his connections with Khabibullina. Be careful upon exiting and avoid getting shot, it's heavily patrolled by Raiders and PMCs.
sources.674652a3507f4bb1aecd1086 description: Buddy, glad to see you once again. Sit down. Sergey discovered some information about two of the so-called 'False Prophets.' It seems they are a group of men who hold enough power to influence weak-minded people, earning their trust with mere charisma. One of these guys used to work as a janitor at Chemical Plant No. 16, the other  They are brothers, no idea of their real names but they go by 'Killa' and 'Tagilla', two very powerful figures here in Tarkov. Locate them in order to reveal the location of our next 'False Prophet'.
sources.687b616db015c21f329bf45f description: Come in, have a seat. I’ve got something unusual for you today. Sergey’s buried in his own work, tinkering with some high-priority builds. He asked me to deal with it, but I’m stretched thin keeping the reserve in check. Looters are crawling all over, and I’m out here playing whack-a-mole with them, so I’m passing this to you. There’s an AN94 stashed out there, left by someone who wants to stay in the shadows. No names, no details, just how they like it. The rifle’s hidden somewhere at the old makeshift military base near the lake. There’s a list of attachments and mods they want on it. I trust you to get it done right and not run off with the gun.  Get it done, and bring it back to me. I’ll make sure it gets to where it’s supposed to go.
sources.68561cd4801134be939e11f6 description: Hello mercenary. You know how memories creep up from the old days. Back when I was running things at the Factory I overheard my boss talking about a rare antique smoothbore pistol. Kept it in a fancy display case. Word is it was gifted to some accountant he dealt with. I want that piece for myself now. Something about the craft of it calls to me. Check the Black Knight building over in Military Reserve. That's where that accountant's office used to be. Find it and bring it back. I’ll make it worth your while.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 description: Good afternoon Mercenary. We’ve got a messy situation brewing. Those hostile factions out in Woods are hitting our UN aid convoys hard. The world needs to see it plain and clear. I want you to plant three UNTAR tags near their hotspots. Stick them on some executed bodies. Once the news catches wind that BEAR and USEC are butchering blue helmets donations to our operations will pour in. It’s about saving lives through the right kind of spotlight.
sources.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 description: Our Swedish pals seem to have lost a hard drive during their little "audit" of Tarkov’s relief operations. Go fetch it from their abandoned armored vehicle out in the Streets. That drive’s got some juicy details: tax havens, embargoed tech deals, shipping manifests... Get it to me and we could nudge Stockholm into redirecting some UN aid budgets our way. Wouldn’t it be a pity if their shady deals with TerraGroup got out?
sources.686c25d281071c45d2f8aa44 description: Good afternoon Mercenary. We’ve got a problem that needs fixing fast. I secured a shipment of M249 SAWs but my team got hit during delivery. Some of those weapons were snatched. Worse yet the manifest listing every gun got lost in the chaos. I need that paperwork to know exactly what’s missing. Head to the Tigr LAV by the main bridge on Customs. That’s your best bet to find it. Clear?
sources.686dd4f871840e292fbd1a14 description: Those fucking bastards! I believe I know who attacked my convoy that was carrying my shipment of the M249 SAW! One of my guys told me it looked like a small group of Ex-USEC guys. I need you to go back to Customs and take care of them for me while I figure out why the fuck they stole my guns. I bet those bastards have them stashed somewhere.
sources.6870170d18b94df2e8700ba0 description: Alright Mercenary, we got more work. While you were out playing shadow my guy was poking around Customs tracking down my stolen guns. Turns out those bastards stashed them in crates tucked away on some storage shelves in a damn corner. They better not have messed with my gear.
sources.6877096d5299037a1c4b7b2f description: Here is the scoop - I got some weapons in, but I need someone to do a little bit of testing for me to see if they are worth it. You are the best man for the job, so take this gun and go kill some Scavs for me. This should be pretty easy for you. I will give you some cash also for doing so. Good luck!
sources.68784cf8dbe00560604d51e1 description: Hello again. It looks like I can get more variants of the gun I had you test. I am gonna ask again if you can run a few tests for me again, but this time I want the test to be bit harder. Go kill PMC's in certain areas of Tarkov.
sources.6879a0da60f8d8a90e632755 description: Alright, Merc. I have one more task for you. I got the other shipments of those weapons you tested for purchase. The last thing I am going to ask is you to kill more PMCs, but this time at night. If this goes well I can get one more variant of the weapon and this one looks badass.
sources.694dc176d149fc1d52000003 description: Hey merc, we've got an issue. As usual it's money, but don't worry I'm not asking you for more at the moment. You can fill our coffers as needed another way. You see as of right now my... management doesn't see things here as particularly noteworthy or dangerous. I'd like to put a bug in their ear with evidence to prove that we need some heavier firepower to protect us in the region. I'm thinking some standard shells for the BTR I've seen wandering around the area should disappear from the reserve base arsenal and reappear at the place where the BTR stops a couple hundred meters north of the sawmill. You might find some around their motorpool, they have to unload the guns to work on them after all. As always, you'll find your pockets full after the fact. See to it.
sources.687314e1ee500b06711955a2 description: Greetings comrade. When the blockade kicked off and most of the reserve base boys ditched the place Glukhar and his crew of scavengers busted into the weapons testing area and grabbed whatever they could get their filthy hands on. Most of that gear is long gone, used up or trashed. But word is the scraps they left behind are about to be moved. Glukhar’s planning to spread his rot further across our land.
sources.6873248b615c003311ebb292 description: "Yo, merc, got a weird one for ya. Some high-roller client of mine’s got a hard-on for his old-school stuff, and he’s paying big to get it back. He’s after some old game console and a bootleg Star Wars DVD he stashed somewhere at the Health Resort. Problem is, I was three vodkas deep when he told me the room number, so I got no clue where exactly. You’ll need to sniff around the resort’s fancy suites y’know, the ones with the plush carpets and overpriced views. Once you’ve nabbed the goods, drop ‘em off at the mini theater in Interchange, in the back somewhere by the poster he said. Don’t even think about popping that DVD in for a watch or selling it for a quick buck, don't try fucking with that  game console either. This guy’s obsessive, and I ain’t dealing with his tantrums. They're messy; do this clean, and we’ll talk more work."
sources.686051774a290eb6f216471f description: I tracked down tracked down a shipment of NATO weapons that was delivered to Customs. We aren't sure what the weapons are, but I want you to go and track them down and mark the shipment for me!
sources.ff2c2fd5d1e216e8aa91f992 description: I'm sure you've seen the state of the city lately eh? Fuckin rough place. Absolute dumpster fire of a situation. I tell you what, we can kick this thing off if you can whack some of the local upstarts who think they're something just because they have a rusted shitty kalash. Got some American green in it for you if you can paint the street with ten of them.
sources.be3c5ff9d7033690c03b761b description: Hey man, I know I only just met you but it would help me greatly if I had something to snack on while I try to figure out what I want to do next. Now don't take me for a lazy bastard, I swear I've looked all over for this shit before I bothered asking you. Maybe I'm just not looking in the right places, who fucking knows, I'm not from here. But I want some sausage and crackers. It would just be nice. I wouldn't consider this a need, but if you come across some in your travels it would be appreciated. Thanks.
sources.67296afd6e3127842d3a2e42 description: Hello again traveler. I figure you can see that I'm not in that great of sorts as of lately and I'd appreciate your help in helping me solve some of my issues. I know they're my issues to solve, but just given that you've been around for longer than me, I'm sure you know the neighborhoods much better than I. There are some drunkards who have been rooting through my shit lately and don't care what I threaten them with, so I hope you'd be okay taking some more of them out. The payment will be much more generous this time. This time though, bring me their weapons as proof they're dead. And here's a freebie if you can use it, seeing as you're working for me. Thanks again.
sources.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 description: Another person caught in the net of the blockade. A visitor from the west was vacationing here just prior to the conflict and overstayed his welcome in Tarkov and got stuck in the bear trap. Him and I have been discussing quite a lot though, and I think we could all use his connections and skills. He worked on firearms back home professionally, you understand? So he needs some things in order to get his business started over here, since he's not exactly going anywhere anytime soon. Here's your list, now get to it.
sources.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 description: Alright the deal is I see guys creeping up into my floor pretty much every night looking for my front door. I'm sick of them, since I can't even sleep anymore due to this shit. I've barricaded the stairs leading up to my floor, but they keep coming anyways, bastards. I think if they learn that the stairs detonate every time they try to get past my barricades, they'll probably stop sooner rather than later. Find the stairs I've blocked and put tripwires in the barricade so that disturbing the barricade sets it off.
sources.691ecb9b1664a484f03a2611 description: Kill 25 PMCs with the FNX-45 Tactical .45 ACP pistol
sources.691ecbb23b845bc0903a2612 description: Kill 50 PMCs with the FNX-45 Tactical .45 ACP pistol
sources.691ecbc872bfcbd28b3a2616 description: Kill 100 PMCs with the FNX-45 Tactical .45 ACP pistol
sources.fc669d6e8d3ccdbc735fff53 description: Come in, kid. Before all this, I used to keep hunting magazines and dream about taking a double rifle somewhere far away, where the animals were bigger than a car. Two barrels, two cartridges, and no room for carelessness. Never made that trip. Now the trouble is here, in my own woods. Take your .700 out there and deal with the looters from a proper distance. I want to see whether you can handle that rifle, or just like the noise it makes. A contact of Mechanic's helped me put together a soft-point load. Show me you know what you're doing, and I'll set some aside for you.
sources.93fca392a75ac1e0b05cfd10 description: In the woods, you can choose where to watch from. Between walls, the man coming after you might choose the distance. I've seen people get killed because a powerful rifle gave them more confidence than sense. Take your .700 and deal with the mercenaries up close. Learn when to move and when to find cover to reload. Remember, there are only two shots before you have to open those barrels. I've prepared another load, eight heavy pellets instead of a single bullet. Called it Cerberus. A fitting name for something meant to guard a passage, don't you think?
sources.8bf7e85422290ecae416b1d8 description: I worked security at that factory before everything went to hell. Now some bastard in a mask, carrying a hammer, has decided the place belongs to him. Tagilla. He puts on steel and treats people like prey. That's where your last test is. Take the .700 and bring him down with the loads you already have. Mechanic's contact has put together a hardened penetrator held in a four-piece polymer sabot. I called it Goliath. It's expensive, and I won't hand it over to someone who thinks power is a substitute for judgment. You know the rifle by now. Show me you know its limits, too.
sources.68d3eabc22a258476b064851 description:
Heya, brother! You probably already know what this is about. Yes, those same lists you really can't afford to drop out of.

So what does that mean? That's right, we keep working and showing just how good we are. The tasks are the same, just with a few small changes.

Yup, it gets harder each time, but isn't that how life always is?

Alright, get to work.
sources.68d3eb2b2712147eab000f21 description:
Hello-hello! I won't waste your time, let's get straight to the point.

Our reputation is holding strong, but we want more and better, right? So we can't afford to slack off.

The lists are updated all the time, and we can make it to the very top. All you have to do is complete everything on the list.

Yes, it's tough, yes, it takes a while, but the reward matches the effort.
sources.fd1b683d79e097d49bacc63b description: Hey, merc. Got a little shipment nobody was expecting. VR80, Rock Island Armory. American name on the box, made in Turkey. Looks familiar enough to you operators, but it eats twelve-gauge shells. Before the blockade, stuff like this was meant for shooting clubs. Now it can earn its keep around here. A few idiots at Customs have been making trouble for my boys. Clear them out with a twelve-gauge, and bring me a couple packs of fresh Wilston you find out there. I'll let you trade for one of these imports. Bottles and cigarettes still move, even when the banks don't. Fair business, right?
sources.35e933725dd8e5e778e3ad71 description: There you are. Remember those VR80s? A couple of regular customers have their eye on them. Nice shape, detachable mags, all that. But I sell guns that work, not pretty boxes. Take one to Customs and put it through some real work. There are still bastards shaking down people who do business with me. Ten of them should get the message across. If the shotgun holds up and you come back with results, I'll keep a few assembled for you. No need to chase bottles every time. Roubles will do. That's how a regular customer gets treated.
sources.dd5168501c5131632cca3e2a description: Got something else for you. Separate business, don't worry about the other jobs. Some people at Customs need to stop asking questions, and a few of your mercenary friends have been getting too interested in my affairs. I want it handled without turning the whole place into a firing range. Take a twelve-gauge with a suppressor. Eight Scavs at Customs and three operators, wherever you catch them. Any shotgun that fits the bill will do. Meanwhile, I'm having a VR80 put together with a Salvo, an EOTech, and a bigger mag. A little arrangement for customers who know how to keep their mouths shut. Bring me some valuables afterwards and it's yours.
sources.29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 description: Come on in, have a seat. Need a ride? A boat, you say, to reach a ship out in the gulf. Nah man. I barely got this BTR back on its feet, no time for boats. But I know someone. Picked up some parts from smugglers before, they've got all kinds of junk lying around. Might have something that floats too. They don't usually deal with your kind, but I can ask around. Relax man, I'll be heading that way anyway. Although you could do something to improve your chances. They've got a stash where too many outsiders have been showing up lately. You clear out those guests, I'll let the smugglers know it was you who helped. It's north of the port terminal, around where the health resort is. Go down from the resort toward customs, there's a big open field. Past that you'll see a few hangars with shipping containers. By the time you're done and back, I'll have info for you.
sources.e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 description:
I already told you everything in the car. But if you really wanna get the smugglers to put in a more comfortable transport option to Icebreaker, you'll need to help them out with their fight against the Rogues first.

Looks like things between them are pretty serious, and honestly I have no idea where it's going worst. So you can take initiative anywhere you want, just make sure there are fewer Rogue fighters left. Otherwise the smugglers won't even listen to you, they've got bigger problems right now.
sources.8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 description:
You did pretty well helping with the Rogues, and the smugglers actually came to me themselves. One of their commanders is being held by those bastards over at the water treatment plant, and the guys want to get their own man back.

But for that, they need a reliable route from Priozersk to the Rogue base. If you help with that, maybe we can talk about your request too. You'll need to go along the path from the nature reserve to the lighthouse and mark the start and end of the route.
sources.c7a1f0b93e64d5827ab1cc40 description: Alright, well the smugglers managed to get their commander out, though not without losses. I'm heading over to talk things through and ask about you as well. But you get it, right now they need to both celebrate the win and properly remember the ones they lost. So I can't show up empty-handed. You gonna help set the table?
sources.3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 description: I went over to the guys, we had a real good talk... When you're ready, just come see me and I'll tell you everything, uh... In person!
sources.ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 description: So you found that poster about the TerraGroup and Paradigm Shipping merger. I know the deal. A few years back, TerraGroup acquired a controlling stake in Paradigm Shipping. In practice, the company became just another TerraGroup subsidiary. A fleet under their control, ready to move whatever cargo they want. That doesn't give them any special rights when it comes to transporting hazardous materials, but you and I both know how TerraGroup treats official restrictions. And they didn't buy carriers that big just to cut transport costs. I've been meaning to look into this for a while. I specifically searched for information, but even serious journalists haven't produced a single investigation on the subject. Although now it feels like we might have a chance to figure it out ourselves. The day before yesterday I intercepted a distress signal coming from the water, clearly not military. It looks like a large vessel got stuck inside the blockade perimeter and hasn't shown any signs of life this whole time. And now they've suddenly established contact with someone in Tarkov. What were they talking about? I don't know. My setup wasn't meant for intercepting maritime comms, and the signal is weak. You could help with that, however. Nothing complicated. There's a communications tower in the northwestern part of the nature reserve that can give us a cleaner signal. That's what needs to be repaired. Northern part of the Priozersk nature reserve. Look for a red-and-white cellular tower, not far from the Scav bunker. Take a toolset with you.
sources.07c1ecde2c4652876fc769b1 description: While I dig for information online, you work the ground. But you won't be able to get into the port terminal. Thinking about the unloading zones, or that terminal with their logo on the customs territory? Unlikely anything is still there. Try the railway station near the lighthouse instead. Most of their cargo passed through there, beyond the water treatment plant. There's no point searching the containers themselves, but the nearby hangar might still have documents. Shipping manifests, freight directives, anything with the icebreaker's name on it. Bring me what you find.
sources.9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 description: Now we know what the ship is, so the only question left is how you get aboard and, more importantly, how you get back off. I can find the exact position of "Boreas", but I can't move you across the water and I can't pull you off a deck in the middle of the gulf. That part is on you. Think about who still has access to working vehicles around here.
sources.6a7e0916b881de241018539d description:
Good day, my friend. A word about that ship in the bay, if you have a minute.

Some weeks ago my people impounded a transport container that came off that vessel. Inside, a full kit for a soldier, all of it new, none of it carrying a manufacturer stamp or a unit marking. Officially it is now UN property and it sits in a warehouse under my signature. Unofficially, I would like very much to know who it was addressed to.

The men on that ship wear the same equipment and answer to no government I am aware of. That is a problem for the Blue Helmets, and problems are expensive. So let us keep this simple. Thin them out, ten will do, and bring me their identification tags. Any variant, I am not particular. My people cannot file a report on a group that does not officially exist, but a handful of tags is a beginning.

Do this, and the container becomes surplus. Surplus can be sold, to you, at a fair price. You understand how these things work.
sources.6aa83f652bec3212bf930001 description:
Greetings. I have an urgent assignment for you. You are not yet aware of the situation, so I will need to provide some context. However, everything I am about to disclose is top secret, understood?

There is a secured facility within the blockade perimeter that is of interest to my contacts in the nuclear energy sector. The issue is that it is an icebreaker ship, currently stranded in the bay. To access it, you will need to acquire suitable transport, and it is preferable to do so quietly. No one must know that the vessel is present in Tarkov’s waters at all!

Once you secure transport, you are to retrieve operational documentation from the ship. Search the engineering sections, there should be a logbook for the nuclear power unit control system. Do not, under any circumstances, disclose this task to anyone.
sources.6aa83f652bec3212bf930002 description:
It looks like you will have to return to the Icebreaker after all. The data from the nuclear power plant logbook was not sufficient. Our partners need real-time readings from the power unit, so I've purchased a special device from Mechanic for remote connection to the central control station.

Before you install it, however, you must ensure that all equipment in the technical areas is functioning properly. Take tools with you and restore the circuit breakers that have been taken offline, then install this device in the control room.

I have been informed that the damaged breakers are likely located in three areas. One is directly on the way to the engine room, near the locker rooms with coats. The second is directly beneath that section. The third is somewhere in the corridors running along the engine compartment.

Once you have restored all breakers, return to the central control station. Install the device there and report back.
sources.87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a description: Unusual transport, you say? Hm... Lucky you. Very lucky. I do need something, pronto, so we have a deal. Bring me a few military power filters, and I'll sort out transport for you. What kind of transport you're looking for? I don't give a damn. My helicopter can get you anywhere, as long as it's not out of Tarkov. Yes, I have a helicopter. I've got a lotta things. But until you bring me those filters, I'm not even thinking about your request.
sources.6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 description: The bird needs maintenance before it flies anywhere, and that means proper fluids. Check the Reserve base. You'll need aviation oil, called AMG-10. It's stored in canisters or special containers. The army kept aviation supplies around their vehicle depots and warehouses, so start there. Bring the canister back in one piece and we're another step closer to your ride.
sources.6a75661b478c184bd220c433 description: Heya there, warrior! Since you already know about my little helicopter secret, I've got a job for you. If you want my bird to keep picking you up from the ship, it needs regular maintenance. Remember that special lubricant you brought me? You won't find that stuff in Tarkov, but there should still be some supplies left on the Icebreaker. Go take a look, check the helipad and storage areas. Anything you find in cans, bring it back to me. You've got your own interest in this too, so you won't be doing it for nothing. And if you manage to pull together a decent stock, I'll even pay extra.
sources.6a753b58478c184bd220c417 description: Hello, mercenary. In field conditions it is extremely important to anticipate any potential hazards in advance. Once a patient is already on the operating table, you can only work with whatever is available at hand. That is why I would like you to bring me high-dose potassium iodide tablets. Yes, these are used in cases of severe radiation exposure. And no, we have not recorded any leaks recently. I must ask you not to spread information about this order. You do not realize how severely panic among the population can complicate the work of my department. I am simply preparing for any incidents that may occur in the future. The issue is that in Tarkov itself we have never found this dosage. Such preparations are typically stored at nuclear facilities, as they are only relevant there. I hope your search proves more successful than that of my staff.
sources.6a753cf3478c184bd220c426 description: This icebreaker you've found is a real discovery! If it is located that far out, there could still be medical equipment on board that survived the blast in the city center... We will not get a second opportunity like this. In conditions of isolation and the inability to provide full hospital care, we usually rely on specialized biochemical analyzers. They allow us to perform a wide range of tests quickly and with the necessary accuracy. However, most of the reserve units in Tarkov were taken by emergency services during the evacuation. But on the icebreaker there could still be analyzers in working condition. Especially if it is connected to TerraGroup. Search for them for me, preferably several. The ship likely had its own medical section where they could have been installed.
sources.695c99f4138ce4c3ccb622ef description: Merc, is that you? Good, I got a task for you. Our local "compatriots" have been overstepping their boundaries recently. The UN mission is supposed to be the primary peacekeeping force according to the resolution that was drafted in relation to the conflict here, but it seems the Russians are looking to expand their own operations. They so happen to be encroaching on our activities, and that's making my foreign partners a bit nervous. So, I want you to take care of that. Give them a nice scare, wiping out one of their sections should do the trick. I'll leave you a package once you're done that should make up for any unwanted attention you receive.
sources.695c9bb87f63551bef72cecb description: Guess that wasn't enough, now there's russkie patrols all over the territory. We're going to have to hit them where it hurts. I need you to target their leadership, make a point out it this time. Maybe Prapor will personally put a stop to this if he's loosing his trusted men.
sources.695c96ccf3389a5ab3f594e6 description: Hey, coming in at just the right time. I've been having trouble with the authorities recently, real pain in the ass they are. They keep stopping my dudes and "confiscating" the cargo. Yeah right, my ass! Bet they're keeping it for themselves. Seems Prapor has been doing a poor job keeping his guys equipped and instead sells it to people like you. Anyways, you can probably tell how much this is affecting business. So here's the deal, you go pop some of those troopers that like to patrol my routes, and I'll make sure you're compensated for the buzz it's gonna draw. How's that sound?
sources.69085a524e8082229957904c description: So much dedication to talk to us; is it an internal contact or a USEC informant? Are you looking for information? We are USEC, or rather, we are THE USEC, much more USEC than those who created it. Anyway, I don't work with just anyone, so why don't we start with you showing me how much you are willing to invest in this partnership?
sources.6908cc9eba0a887c798e1f11 description:
Have you ever wondered how much valuable data is stored on TerraGroup's servers? Information about scientific research, military projects, illegal activities, such as unethical experiments and corporate espionage, and, of course, civilian data...

Tarkov is packed with Secured Flash Drives everywhere. You know what to do.
sources.6908e22349d63fbaf2dd3b9a description:
It's been a while since Mechanic sent you on a mission to collect a very valuable Hard Drive. That complex is much more important than it looks, and that's why you are going back there and setting up a few things for me.

Your first objective is at the drop-off point of a USEC PMC team. I can see from the cameras that everyone was eliminated, so mark the vehicle that dispatched the group. 

Your second objective will be on the route these PMCs took, or rather, tried to take. I can see one taken out while hiding behind a barricade. 

As a final objective, you need to position a radio repeater in the offices. We don't want it to be obvious, so find a discreet location, like near a coffee machine in the break area. 

That's all.
sources.690a2def6c4ba5b7f1e9457d description:
This TerraGroup complex is an area of great interest, and I already have access to the cameras that cover all of Ground Zero, except for two blind spots.

There is a building next to the complex with a good view. Install it near the window where an NSV Utyos machine gun was installed. 

For the second camera... Have you ever had coffee at Coffee Maniac? They say it's great, so maybe behind it near the debris that was left there.
sources.6a4de4da46604165ad7d0ce1 description: Great! With the cameras installed, I need you to keep a close eye on what Mechanic is going to do about this. Don't screw this up!
sources.6a7d316935bfdf8609748f7a description: Tracking Mechanic's moves doesn't mean breaking the cameras I had you plant. Look... honestly, whatever. This was all a waste of time. Just go on with your life in Tarkov.
sources.6a4de6851d3fc0503f000c17 description: Well, I don't think Mechanic is someone worth having as an enemy. I spoke with him recently over the radio and we made some deals. We expect you to act as a bridge here.
sources.690a553efc51c1efb8c22ded description: My next operation will be crucial. Customs has been a turbulent environment, so you will recon the area and get out in one piece. You will have new tasks to do.
sources.690a659d592d4e5a142036bb description: My team is already doing the hard work on Customs, but these Scavs are annoying; they cause trouble, so ensure they have the necessary support.
sources.690ad6e0f4aac3c28195d97c description:
Hello again. You've been doing well so far, and I need you to keep it up. 

Intelligence informed me that other high-relevance traders are sending out contracts for Scav eliminations on Customs. Remember Jaeger? He will be the first, so accept his contract and do it.
sources.690adfb8b6469342b3cbfabc description: Hello, mercenary. Final phase of the operation. I need you to collect some specific equipment for my team; you can find it with Reshala's guards on Customs. These items will play a fundamental role in the next steps.
sources.690af2bed4521bca8e6a2fb9 description:
Do you know what the ISB is? The USEC Intelligence Support Bureau. For a long time, this was a secret division. After Blue Fire, it became a three-front conflict: Bears, USECs, and Scavs. Our role was always behind the scenes, until the day a fourth player wanted to get involved...

TerraGroup is not worth all the blood and suffering this land has witnessed, and this must end. If you think you can be a part of it, you will demonstrate it now with a huge sacrifice. 

Good luck.
sources.690af7eaf5a597ebc0b602f6 description:
Have you ever seen that acronym around? “ISB”… For a long time, we were USEC’s special division, but honestly, this whole thing is getting ridiculous. It’s not just the leadership that’s a failure—it’s this TerraGroup, with all its corruption and exploitation. That kind of shit always happens, and whatever—but they’re up to something much worse, and we have evidence that someone else big is involved in all this chaos in Tarkov. 

The reason I’m wasting my time telling you this is that to work with the “ISB,” you have to prove yourself. How about that.
sources.6910218dea9506c0857ab999 description:
Welcome to the team. You may not have realized the objective of everything we've done so far, but it's quite simple. Did you know Reshala has a kind of association? A syndicate. One of my agents is already infiltrated and close enough to assume high-level positions, and that's why you are going to eliminate ONE single Guard of his, and he will be replaced by one of ours.

It is of extreme importance that you do not eliminate Reshala or any other of his Guards. We will focus all intelligence to ensure more men get close to him. Good luck!
sources.6912aa3f56e36f28b556c7f4 description:
You are too green for special operations. Regardless, every ISB agent specializes in handling almost every type of Western weaponry; after all, that is what we work with here. 

During your time in Tarkov, you must have utilized many different weapons. We cannot risk you getting rusty, so it is time for new training. If you perform well, I guarantee you will have a suitable reward.
sources.6912c61d527bc3f9790b5776 description: It is time to continue practicing, and obviously, our expectations of you are increasing. You need to keep training with Western weapons if you wish to reach an exemplary standard. We are counting on you.
sources.6912c8df72a190f1caae8298 description:
Half the path has been walked; I hope it is being minimally entertaining. Actually, I don't. 

Your performance has been notable and quite impressive, and we hope you continue developing to become an excellent agent.
sources.6912cbdcf7e36ec0ee1de240 description:
How did you make it this far? I hope it isn't becoming tiresome to use these beautiful weapons, because for someone to think that would be OFFENSIVE to me. 

Regardless, you are doing very well, and I hope you are also satisfied with the rewards.
sources.6912ceca14c4d7453878e335 description:
When you and Jaeger were digging for information about us, I thought you would be just another couple of poor souls we would have to make disappear. I confess I am relieved I didn't have to make that decision, and that is why I am also proud to say that this is your final test. 

Good luck.
sources.6913af3e41d70209e1c9dc13 description: I love the Five-seveN, so we will start with it. I'm going to give you a sequence of tasks so you can prove your skill with several different weapons normally used by our team. Exciting, isn't it? So let's start with this beautiful weapon, so good it was banned in several places, but obviously, not for us.
sources.6913fe5afc7a709d1e0aeba6 description: The beautiful P90. It was manufactured by FN Herstal, the same manufacturer as the Five-seveN. Powerful caliber and surprising fire rate, making it worthy of a challenge to match.
sources.69141e39dc0b928717fdd14b description: I'm not such a fan of SIG Sauer weapons, with the exception of their pistols, but the AR configuration makes many adore this submachine gun, so it will be part of the test. Have a nice trip to Customs.
sources.69142292070bcc615773f970 description: We have finally arrived at one of my favorite weapons, and of course, I couldn't leave you with an easy challenge. Heckler & Koch is quite a manufacturer; a submachine gun with so much firepower. You will manage to complete the challenge easily.
sources.6914f92790fe68c14629e795 description: Look at Heckler & Koch again. Let's change the weapon type a bit and start with DMRs. My people use them quite a lot during missions—the standard procedure: some stay back protecting the team from afar while others advance. Higher fire rate, more control and precision. I hope you enjoy DMRs.
sources.6914eaa069904863f3247ecd description: Another high-standard DMR. Perfect stability and an impressive fire rate, besides having a resemblance to the AR configuration as well. I just handed you some good things, so it's time to put them into action.
sources.69150a9cc13d182f8d1e6636 description: You have come quite far, that is great! Now let's raise the bar a bit. Have you ever operated with a .338 caliber weapon? It is incredible, powerful, and very unique, which is why I am willing to give you some very interesting rewards if you complete this challenge. Good luck!
sources.691509a8317f46ac275c10c4 description: We have reached the Sniper Rifles. My people rely heavily on precision, patience, and calm, so this time I want to demand a little more accuracy from you. I am sure you are capable.
sources.691514d147e21d507ab4c72f description:
Remember what we discussed about the .338 caliber? There is a Sniper Rifle of this same caliber. Every time I needed to utilize it, it was during missions in Labs, using it like a carbine. It is not safe and I don't recommend it, but I admit it is very fun. 

Just like with the Mk-18, I will demand a complex challenge, but I guarantee you will be rewarded for it. Good luck!
sources.69151f4a0c51debb169cc953 description: Assault Rifles are the main weapons we utilize here, and honestly, the MDR 5.56x45mm is my favorite; that multi-colored design makes it look even better. Anyway, handling a weapon like this is easy, and we hope you achieve many kills with it. Good luck!
sources.69153dcab3aae4e9422e48a0 description: A powerful caliber for an automatic weapon. We expect you to also demonstrate high performance by eliminating some heavily armored bosses. This way, we can thoroughly test both your efficiency and that of the weapon.
sources.691526e16db665e1712d6246 description: I love the HK 416A5, but I recently replaced it with the Radian Weapons Model 1 FA. I hope one day that weapon makes its way to Tarkov. Regardless, this is one of the most used weapons by our team—powerful, high fire rate, and precise—so I will also ask for a more complex challenge. Good luck!
sources.6960292c08a0653253dcd002 description: While I was putting together some HKs for my crew, I heard that some Model 1 FAs have started showing up in Tarkov. It's a pretty rare find right now, so I wish you luck getting your hands on one to finish this task. But I'll tell you this: if you manage to do it, I'll make sure you're properly rewarded with one of our unique Model 1 variants. Who knows, maybe one day I'll even let you buy that model directly from me...
sources.691551f21744ab25e3e9ff77 description: One of our Special Forces members is completely fascinated by this weapon. I see value, but not *that* much. Regardless, I acknowledge that many operators view the MCX-SPEAR as the most powerful weapon, and therefore, this will likely be the greatest challenge you will face. But considering you will have better access to Hybrid ammunition, who is going to stop you after this, right?
sources.69156abce46a469364c4a8ff description: To be an established member of the ISB, good medical knowledge and physical preparation are necessary. Let's start by improving your capabilities.
sources.69156f0aaf9e9c284214e0db description: You collected some items, so let's continue at this same pace and also practice using medications. I await your news!
sources.69157484c8721ef63f2ecd6d description: Your physical fitness is also very important. Furthermore, some treatments need to be done quickly and emergently during combat. You will collect some of these items and continue practicing the use of medications.
sources.6915f6edfd13e8f758865cb6 description: The ability to withstand pain on the battlefield is very valuable, and of course we use many painkillers to facilitate all of this. Whether they are injectors or pills, what you can use fastest to continue the fight is the most valuable thing. Let's continue the training.
sources.691749d56952436319da14c4 description: We often suffer serious enough injuries that can only be resolved with deep surgery. I admit that at first I thought performing surgery on yourself during a battle was the most insane thing possible, but unfortunately, it became common. Let's practice that.
sources.6917555e3dc047dac768f90a description: You seem to have learned how to use the CMS Kits well, but you must have realized that they are very improvised, and that doesn't result in quality surgery. That's why you will now use the Surv12. I await your return.
sources.6917c69ad2e7971e1ca792c1 description: Injectors. I hope you're not afraid of needles. TerraGroup and other manufacturers have created various types of injectors that can help you get out of complicated situations in combat or even outside of it. Some are very valuable in fights, so you will learn to identify them and, of course, use them. Good luck!
sources.6a6a30b9ba24bd7648105576 description:
You're back? You were gone for so long. It looks like we're really going to go through a few more things together in this run-down place.

Well, I really appreciate you contributing to the training of my personnel; you were very important in all of this.

I hope you get used to it quickly, because I guarantee you: while you were away, all of this reached a whole new level of evolution. The ISB will be simply superior, that is my condition.

See you around!
sources.6917f4864286e5bd06fc451d description: Being in the ISB requires not only skill and knowledge but demonstrating the highest level of both. Our academy is not easy, and I won't judge you if you don't even want to try, but if you manage to go through everything, you deserve a valuable reward in addition to my... respect. I hope you succeed.
sources.6927c77a68a96ac088d64954 description:
In here, we have an interesting workflow when it comes to weapons. Our field agents eventually neutralize BEAR and RUAF agents, it happens... Anyway, we have a habit of investigating and understanding the enemy's equipment, so our engineering team disassembles the weapons, identifies the parts individually, and makes a list. We then send it to Tier 2 to assemble them so we can confirm the configuration. 

Since most of our Tier 2 personnel are busy, you'll be in charge of this task. To be fair, since you're assembling non-Western weapons, I'll pay you in Roubles. I heard Mechanic has already asked you to build some weapons; it's similar. Since I'm in a great mood, I'll disassemble one of my Glocks and send you the list just like the engineering team does, so you can get used to it, okay? 

Equipment Description 

Weapon: GLOCK 17 9x19 pistol 
Type: Suppressed 
Ergonomics: 70 
Horizontal Recoil: 216 
Vertical Recoil: 258

sources.692a6a8bfe6ebf8a133bea5e description:
Now that you've partially understood, let's start with the real work. We've acquired a very simple PP-19-01, but even simple ones need to have their manufacturing and model precisely recorded. We're counting on you.

sources.692a6e6ad008d27306f38d5c description:
We recently picked up an interesting AKM. Reduced magazine, visually restored. I confess I didn't find it very efficient, but some engineers here are interested in building its blueprint, so we'll leave it in your hands again. 

Equipment Description 

Weapon: Kalashnikov AKM 7.62x39 assault rifle

sources.692a796ed1317f01a0d461e1 description:
We recently detained a BEAR operator who was armed with a very interesting STM-9 Gen.2 9x19 carbine. It has many cool modifications for a semi-automatic weapon of such a small caliber. Our team rebuilt the gun, but they got busy with another task and told me it's missing just one part to be 100% ready. From my experience, it's something involving the stock or the tube. Good luck finding out! 

Equipment Description 

Weapon: STM-9 Gen.2 9x19 carbine 
Type: Suppressed 
Ergonomics: 61.5 
Horizontal Recoil: 147 
Vertical Recoil: 29
sources.692d248d323b786edd54307e description:
9x39mm caliber rifles are very interesting and are barely used by NATO or Western forces. We have a new request from the engineers for a KBP VSK-94. Good luck! 

Equipment Description 

Weapon: KBP VSK-94 9x39 rifle 
Type: Suppressed 
Ergonomics: 51 
Horizontal Recoil: 157 
Vertical Recoil: 62 

Equipment Specifications 

Stock: Standard 
Grip: Standard

Scope Mount 2: RS Regulate AKR top mount 
Sight: SIG Sauer ROMEO7 1x30 reflex sight (prototype) 
Mount: B-3 mount 
Tactical Device 1: SureFire X400 Ultra tactical flashlight with laser
sources.692d2b4e5f3b1677b9c04834 description:
We've received information that a group of BEARs collaborated with some Scavs to mass-produce SV-98s adapted for long-range combat with high precision. It's a cheap setup, but if we have the opportunity to ruin their plan, we'll take it. I need you to build an SV-98 bolt-action sniper rifle with the worst possible configuration; anything you want to take off or put on is fine. We just need it to have three things. 

- 10-round capacity magazine 
- Leapers UTG 25mm ring scope mount 
- VOMZ Pilad 4x32 25.4mm riflescope
sources.692d310cbdf122e5296a2c12 description: Our intelligence reported that a Scav left the original plans for the rifle on top of the building known as 'Queen' in Reserve. Your goal is to retrieve the original plans and replace them with these from the weapon you built. Additionally, I need you to leave a message to be convincing, so eliminate anyone with that terrible gun you made. We're counting on you.
sources.692dd0b1cda5a668af01ce3f description:
We almost never go near Interchange, but recently Killa's movements caught our attention. He's famous for his RPK and heavily armored gear, so we want to test if our own RPK is a match for him. I'll forward you the blueprint. 

Equipment Description 

Weapon: RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun 
Type: Suppressed 
Ergonomics: 40 or higher 
Horizontal Recoil: 225 
Vertical Recoil: 76 

Equipment Specifications

Muzzle: AK-74 Hexagon 5.45x39 sound suppressor
sources.692e70c70f46140eb149e9b0 description:
Since your last task, I really liked that GL-Shock stock, so I asked my people to work with it on a new project. We've noticed an increase in PMCs near our command post here on Lighthouse using AK-12 rifles, so they set up a project to test it. But please, test it far from here because I really can't stand hearing the sound of that gun anymore.

Type: Suppressed

sources.692e773e3b10698b80de19dd description:
Ever met Kaban? Don't worry, I won't send you to Streets of Tarkov, but during some reconnaissance, we noticed that some of his personal bodyguards use SAG AK-545 carbines. By default, it's an interesting gun, so we gathered some info to build one—or rather, for you to build one. 

Equipment Description 

Weapon: SAG AK-545 5.45x39 Carbine 
Type: Unsuppressed 
Ergonomics: 100 
Horizontal Recoil: 171 
Vertical Recoil: 59 

Equipment Specifications

sources.694bf7616e308ab55b47cef6 description: Hello, mercenary. We are making some headway into Shoreline—after all, it’s close to the port currently being used as an evacuation point. Our intelligence has intercepted some concerning details about the situation there, which we’ll share as soon as we can. Anyway, we need to do a little 'cleanup' in the area to move forward with our operations. We’re counting on you.
sources.694bfb731131e30433a6d95f description: Recently, we’ve been working with some UN officers from the mission in Tarkov—UNTAR. Honestly, collaborating with them is always a headache. No matter how much chaos is breaking loose, they’re always breathing down our necks, yet it seems other groups don't get the same treatment... funny how that works. Regardless, since we’re already in Shoreline, we need to deliver some supplies.
sources.69614f3852b2d48240d8d604 description: Let's play UNTAR's game and make it look like we actually care about this failed operation of theirs. Get a bit closer to their representative around here, and we'll move forward that way.
sources.6961dfcf46370012416ab8a9 description:
That minimally positive relationship with Peacekeeper actually bore fruit. We received word from some UNTAR officers that certain TerraGroup items will be collected for forensics. They’re starting at Shoreline with the assets at the Smuggler's Base.

Let’s start this game with something light. We need to track those items, but UNTAR isn't that stupid. We’re going to disguise some common devices as mobile phones among those TerraGroup items. To do this, we need to revive an old tracking software located on a flash drive inside the Lab, specifically in the Yellow area. Collect the flash drive, eliminate some targets, and deliver it to our drop-off point at Lighthouse—a burnt-out bus on the main road.

Good luck!
sources.69628af1245be7fe53193f4c description:
The software is updated. While we prepare the next tasks, you need to set up the devices. Take these 1GPhones and the flash drive—your Intelligence Center should be able to handle the job even if it’s not fully upgraded.

Once you have the devices ready, head to the Smuggler's Base on Shoreline and plant them near the TerraGroup items. When UNTAR collects them, they’ll assume the phones are part of the evidence and take them along.

All your objectives are close to each other, so search inside and around one of the upper warehouses. Good luck!
sources.6961a8cf8e0990358ff6db97 description: Dammit! We have a problem. One of our informants reported that a letter from a VIP scientist is mixed in with the belongings you tagged. It must be of extreme importance for us to understand what's happening. I need you to go back urgently, search the areas where you planted the devices for that letter, and bring it to me.
sources.6962f2798e50b93c4bccd95b description: Hello, mercenary. We’ve intercepted communications that some UNTAR officers are patrolling Shoreline. I know this isn't ideal, but we cannot allow them to interfere with the mission in any way. Neutralize them as non-lethally as possible and without being identified.
sources.6963c6ff4dae57a2dec4ef82 description: Hello, mercenary! I noticed you're having some trouble finding the UNTAR officers. Don't worry, they are already in my agents' sights as well. Regardless, we can bolster our counterintelligence operation, and that should be enough. Get me some items, and I’ll consider your task complete.
sources.69648a944599e194c4f71339 description: Things are getting very strange on this end. Did you read that letter? I hope not—after all, I didn't ask you to. Regardless, the letter mentions a parallel TerraGroup operation involving new contractors, which has obviously piqued my interest. I spent a long time investigating this and found nothing—absolutely nothing. But I doubt it's a lie. The only thing I discovered is that a PMC was kidnapped near the Port on Shoreline; he was camping in a green truck when he vanished. I need you to find any clues about this.
sources.6966997707f67fea67fe3e18 description: My team is looking into the card, and I’ve already contacted a few people regarding that dogtag. As for the container, we couldn't get it open no matter what we tried. I’ve asked Mechanic to take a look, so I need you to deliver it to him. After that, we’ll continue investigating. Sources have informed me that Sanitar is holding some vital information inside the TerraGroup Lab. Let's solve two problems at once: eliminate Sanitar, secure the card, and find that information in The Lab. Good luck!
sources.69892a1e2a1bffdacffb1b70 description:
Hello again, mercenary! My people are handling that radio, but I personally checked the flash drive, and it’s protected by some very unusual encryption. Luckily, I know a cryptography specialist.

Here’s the plan: I’ve already handed the drive over to this contact, so now you’re heading to Shoreline to deliver his payment—specifically, weapons and ammo. He has a history with RPKs, so leave them in the bathroom of East Wing Room 306, along with some ammo boxes. I'm counting on you!
sources.6989641b1ee424d6c211066f description:
My contact got back to me with some information. It seems like incomplete operational details reporting movement in Shoreline at points where Sanitar usually operates. This is very strange—Sanitar doesn't have such a vast intelligence network.

The current data leads to two points on Shoreline. Go there and look for information.
sources.698a7d1a29aa7cda419b8fbf description:
*Cough-cough*, Aghrr. Dammit! What a perfect time for you to show up... if you’d been in here just a few seconds ago, who knows what would've happened. Well, I was uneasy about that radio and went to take another look. When I picked up that laptop to check them together, I heard some clicks from the radio. That piece of junk had an explosive attached—likely proximity-triggered.

Luckily, I managed to throw it away from me and everyone else. We have some wounded, but everyone’s alive. That’s what matters.

We need you to bring some medical supplies since the place where I tossed the radio was exactly where our storage was. We’re counting on you.
sources.698a82e7f718234ac7702f3d description:
We’re doing better now, and we discovered something... interesting. The first thing I did was isolate part of the device you delivered—or at least what was left of it—to ensure it wasn't another bomb. Once confirmed, we tried to recover everything possible. I also sent two units to scour every place Sanitar or his associates passed through; no signs of explosives or any trace of such a well-planned device being built.

Almost everything we collected on this case was destroyed, but part of the device's hard drive yielded partial documents about Sanitar and his companions... why would he have so much information on himself? We’re starting to believe someone tried to frame him for this operation.

We’re going to find out who it is, whatever the cost, and we start now. My two specialized units—Epsilon-11, codenamed 'Nine-Tailed Fox,' and Titan-2, codenamed 'Silver Wolves'—are taking over operations. I’m temporarily attaching you to the 'Silver Wolves' to participate in their missions. We’ll start slow, but know that every operation is demanding. We’re counting on you.
sources.69a4ae470be691089eeaab09 description:
Let's get to the briefing. The office staff is already handling the intelligence; now it's up to you to provide a response while we haven't reached a definitive conclusion.

Apply maximum pressure and eliminate any hostile that approaches. We need to make an example of them so that whoever is responsible for this attack knows we aren't playing around.

For this mission, you will have to neutralize targets using specific equipment listed below.

Body Armor:
- Any ISB Custom Body Armor.
- Hexatac HPC Plate Carrier (Multicam Black)
- 5.11 Hexgrid Plate Carrier
- BNTI Korund-VM Body Armor
- LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black)
- THOR Concealable Body Armor

Tactical Rigs (Excluding Armored Rigs):
- Any ISB Custom Tactical Rig (Non-armored).
- Triton Dynaforce M43-A Tactical Rig (Black)
- Azimut SS Jhuk Tactical Rig (Black)

Helmets:
- Any ISB Custom Helmet.
- MSA Gallet TC 800 High Cut Combat Helmet (Black)
- Diamond Age Bastion Helmet (Black)
- Ballistic Armor Co. Bastion Helmet (Armor Black)
- Team Wendy EXFIL Ballistic Helmet (Black)
- Age NeoSteel High Cut Helmet (Black)
sources.69b387e8956508586537b309 description:
The operation was a success! We've noticed a retreat among some disorganized Scav and PMC groups across all locations, but that doesn't answer the main question: who planned this attack? I must admit, we had grown complacent here, but that time is over.

Talk to other traders; it's impossible they haven't heard about the explosion near Lighthouse. Ask about explosives, information, or anything that might help. Be discreet. We're counting on you.
sources.69b43d6bab729e30d1339eaa description: We've checked a large portion of the documents. Some of the purchased explosives are restricted military-grade items, and even we had to pull a lot of strings to get our hands on some of them. Continue working with Ref and get more leads; he's a businessman, so you'll have to deal with his offers. Good luck.
sources.69b4501e1b72aba5140989fe description: 50 Million Roubles!? You've got to be kidding me. That's over 300 thousand dollars! If this helps find those bastards, it might just be the right call. I'll make some calls and update you as soon as I can.
sources.69b59b1983251afdcdc79efc description: Well, I've spoken with some other people from high management and they weren't too happy about the situation, but they agreed to release funds for part of the operation. About 80%. You'll have to come up with the rest on your own. Luckily, I have some cool keys here, and I'm going to give you one you probably already know. Good luck!
sources.69e5737ac3095fb436e8d7cc description:
So it seems Ref isn't just collaborating for money. He lost people. Even with my eyes everywhere, I don't have information, not even from the most fanatical ones, about them protecting some TerraGroup cargo on Woods.

This doesn't sound good, but I won't act like I'm surprised. Check the surroundings of the UN Roadblock extraction point. You might find clues there.
sources.69e59b40d943343162400671 description: Let's continue. The document stated the cargo was going to stop at Shoreline for unloading... The only TerraGroup cargo that passed through UNTAR recently over there is sitting at the construction site near the Terminal entrance. Check if you can find any evidence or clues there.
sources.69eb030da45329478b565651 description:
We are slowly getting somewhere. You must already be familiar with the "Rogues", right? Well, let's just say the ISB and them have a... good relationship. I talked to "Knight" and he agreed to help with some devices that can assist us in understanding this drive you found without it, you know, blowing up. He asked for some HKs to resupply their armory. With such a small request, I don't even need to worry that much.

By the way, take this Jammer! It will ensure that if there really is a danger and it can be triggered remotely, the connection will be cut. And yes, we've already planted several around here.
sources.69ec636b09e1a0e9b511a7e5 description: Well, the favors never end... They asked us to proceed with a cleanup plan for enemies, and some Raiders too. Currently, all my personnel are tied up with more important tasks, so we need your freelance services. Take care of some Raiders and enemies on Lighthouse.
sources.6a3cb7cff815823fa45ce5d8 description: We have a lot to wrap our heads around. My people checked the drive and it is heavily encrypted. We asked Mechanic to help with it. Follow up with him and return when you have results.
sources.6a3db1cab8a16aeffe0b456d description: Very well! We are getting close to a conclusion. You already have the Jammer to protect against explosives, the Hard Drive to collect information, and the encryption data and credentials on the Flash Drive. Go to your Intelligence Center and print a complete report while we work on other files.
sources.6a61340adcbc9728913c5d1a description:
The involvement of UNTAR personnel with this whole mess doesn't surprise me; the problem now is the bureaucracy. The United Nations already blocks a large part of my operations for humanitarian reasons. They care more about the image they'll project than the actual results.

I'm going to press them a bit, but I need you to buy us some time. I'll have my people update you with further instructions.
sources.6a616a90b61bd3ebefa646c3 description:
I absolutely hate this bureaucracy. I didn't even have to throw bait at some officers. It seems they already knew we found some of their stuff and demanded that the ISB withdraw from Tarkov immediately to avoid interfering with UNTAR and RUAF roadblock operations. A complete joke, and you know what? I don't care in the slightest.

We need to gather a lot of intel on Woods, so do a preliminary sweep of the area. We're counting on you.
sources.6a61720444238176fd1217ae description:
We are making rapid progress and pushing hard in our search for material against UNTAR. The convoy passed through Interchange, and we will turn the whole place upside down if necessary.

Gear up and do a light sweep, my people will follow up with the heavy cleaning right after. We're going to dig up everything on UNTAR.
sources.6a61916627589288ff590365 description:
This rush is tiring me out, but it doesn't matter. My people turned Interchange inside out and we didn't find much of relevance, just some Scav letters saying they heard rumors about interesting cargo in Ground Zero and Streets of Tarkov.

Moving too fast might draw unnecessary attention, so let's slow the pace down a bit. We have some devices and sensors here that will help in this search, but we are burning through our entire stock of parts for maintenance.
